stages.name: Mention Extraction
stages.description: Detect all NPs, pronouns, and named entities using POS and NER

stages.name: Agreement Filtering
stages.description: Prune candidate antecedents violating gender, number, animacy, or person agreement

stages.name: Syntactic Binding Constraints
stages.description: Enforce Chomsky's Binding Principles A, B, and C

stages.name: Salience / Recency Ranking
stages.description: Rank remaining antecedents via Lappin & Leass salience weights (Subject > Object > Oblique, sentence recency)

stages.name: Coreference Cluster Clustering
stages.description: Unify mentions into transitive equivalence classes
